questions.question: What is the origin and reputation of source IP 185.72.34.21?
questions.why_it_matters: Establishing origin and reputation may help determine whether the login warrants escalation.
questions.evidence_needed: IP reputation results, VPN authentication logs, geolocation, and threat-intelligence records.
questions.related_known_fact: All three recorded events use source IP 185.72.34.21.

questions.question: Was employee01 authorized to access FinanceServer at 02:16?
questions.why_it_matters: Comparing access with approved permissions can establish whether the server activity was expected.
questions.evidence_needed: Access-control lists, identity-provider logs, role assignments, and server audit logs.
questions.related_known_fact: The incident records an access event to FinanceServer for the same account and source IP.

questions.question: Which process or session accessed salary_data.xlsx after the VPN login?
questions.why_it_matters: Tracing the session may clarify whether sensitive data was accessed beyond the initial login.
questions.evidence_needed: File audit logs, endpoint telemetry, VPN session identifiers, and proxy records.
questions.related_known_fact: A file_access event for salary_data.xlsx follows the VPN login in the incident timeline.
